msContents.summary: A paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

supportDesc.foliation: Devanāgarī numerals, top-left and bottom-right margins, verso.

lg.l:
|| kathayaṃtaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ
prabhāvān adbhutān muniṃ ||
lomasaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭiraḥ || 1 ||

|| yo rakṣet prā¦
ṇinnaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi mahāmune || 2 ||

||
ekataḥ kratava sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3 ||

idam eva purā devā
s tulayā samatolayan ||
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 4 ||

atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ
purātanaṃ ||
iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca || 5 ||

varttamāne mahāyajñe | jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpa
m ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatraiva jagmatuḥ || 6 ||

atha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt
|
śaraṇārthaṃ mahīpālaṃ nilinye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7 ||
tataḥ śyenair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvara ||

rājānaṃ
sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 7 || 8 ||

|| dharmmātmānaṃ tvāṃ ihāhur aikaṃ rājan ma
hīkṣitāṃ ||
sa tvaṃ dharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karmma cikīrṣasi || 9 ||

bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛta
vādinaṃ ||
kṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā 'jayat || 10 ||

no'pakāraparo py evam upakāraparo ja
naḥ ||
apakāraparo pi tvam upakāraparo yathā || 11 ||
ahite hitabuddhiṃs tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt ||
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 12 ||
tad evaṃ vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||

mā hiṃ
sīr lobhato dharmmaṃ dharmmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13 ||

|| saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vi
haṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇā nādhnuṃr ayaṃ khagaḥ || 14 ||

tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bha
yātmanaḥ ||
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ || 15 ||

lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajec chara
ṇāgataṃ ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya papam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||

śāstreṣu niḥkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām a¦
pi ||
śaraṇāgatahaṃtas tu na dṛṣṭā nikṛtiḥ kvacit || 17 ||

yathātmani priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ
tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyā prāṇino budhaiḥ || 18 ||

janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāga
re ||
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos trasyaṃti te tathā || 19 ||
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā krodha eva vā ||
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāṃgam api saṃtyajet || 20 ||
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

yu
ktas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ || 21 ||

yathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jī
vitaṃ priyaṃ ||
saṃrakṣato īvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ || 22 ||

tasmān nāham imaṃ
bhītam arppayiṣye kapotakaṃ ||
yad atra yuktaṃ manyase karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 23 ||

|| ā
hārāt sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti janeśvara ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 24 ||

śakye tena vinā¦
py arthaṃ rājan_ varddhayituṃ ciraṃ ||
śakyate duḥkare py arthe cirarātreṇa jīvituṃ || 25 ||

nārthair anyair vināhāraṃ¦
jīvitaṃ kasyacid bhavet ||
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciraṃ || 26 ||

tasmād viyojitasyā¦
rthān_ mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||
vihāya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ || 27 ||

mṛte ca mayi sarvvaṃ me pu
tradāraṃ mariṣyati ||
rakṣamānaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān_ haniṣyasi || 28 ||

dharmmaṃ jo bādhyate dharmmaḥ sa dha
rmmo na mataḥ satāṃ ||
avirodhī tu yo dharmmaḥ sa dharmmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||| 29 ||

tasmād virodhe dharmmasya saṃciṃtaṃ gurulā
laghavaṃ ||
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇayaṃ || 30 ||

bahukalyāṃṇasaṃyuktaṃ
bhāṣase vihagottama ||
suparṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ tvaṃ hi dharmma eva na śaṃsayaḥ || 31 ||

yathā hi dharmmasaṃyuktaṃ ba
hucitraṃ prabhāṣase ||
na te hy aviditaṃ kicid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ | 32 ||

nāto bhūyastaro dharmmaḥ ka
ścid anyo sti khecaraḥ ||
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 33 ||

varam ekasya satvasya dattā
tv abhayadakṣiṇāḥ ||
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ alaṃkṛtaṃ || 34 ||

abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadā¦
ti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimukteasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 35 ||

hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhāḥ
bhuviḥ |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 36 ||

mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate pha
laṃ ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 37 ||
dattaṃm iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā ||

sa
rvvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ || || 38 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ ||

abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūte
bhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ || | 39 ||
api saṃtyajed rājyam idaṃ śaśarīraṃ vāpi dustyajaṃ ||

na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapo
takaṃ | | 40 |
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani ||
bhaveyam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśāna || 41 ||

satyenā
nena bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvara ||
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama || 42 ||

tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāra
m anyam eva dadāmy ahaṃ ||
|| sa eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ || 43 ||

tam emo¦
tsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparair mama ||
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī || 44 ||

mā rāja¦
n sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha ||
|| nīāhaṃ tvācchāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama || 45 ||
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ ||
sarvvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā || 46 ||

vāṅmanaḥ
karmmabhir ye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
dayādarśitapaṃthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 47 ||

gacchatās tiṣṭhato vā
pi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ || 48 ||

jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni¦
sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||
ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te jāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 49 ||

prāṇinaṃ badhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ
śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 50 ||

rājyaṃ śivināṃ sumahat prayacchāmi tava
dvijaḥ ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ || 51 ||

|| yadi rājan kapotena sudṛḍhā
prītir īdṛśī ||
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me || 52 ||

|| anugraham idaṃ manye ya
n māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase ||
etat te haṃ prayacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāviad icchasi || 53 ||

yadi priyaṃ tat tu sujanaś cirād vadati
vā na vā ||
mama tu priyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt || 54 ||
adhruvena śarīreṇa pratyakṣeṇa vināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārpayed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ || 55 ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate ||

tataḥ kim u
pacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā || 56 ||
|| nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃśaṃ nareśvaraḥ ||

tasmā
t kapotena samaṃ prayaccha tulayā dhṛtaṃ || 57 ||
|| tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase ||
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tadvat tava vihaṃgamaḥ || 58 ||

|| evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa
pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ || 59 ||
tyaktvātmasukhabhogecchā sarvvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ || 60 ||
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapote vyatiricyate ||

punaś cotkṛ
tya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 61 ||
na vidyate yathā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||

tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruro
ha tulāṃ svayaṃ || 62 ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nāpekṣyaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api || 63 ||
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnareśvare ||
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca || 64 ||

tatas tasya tadā matvā
devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ ||
śākrasvarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata || 65 ||

|| iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te¦
kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ ||
jijñāsamānau tvaṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 66 ||

naitat sarve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpa
re ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duḥkaraṃ nṛpaḥ || 67 ||
parārthaṃ tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava ||

prāṇasaṃśaya
lubdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ || 68 ||
parārthaikāṃtakalyāṇasvaśraiyo tyaṃtaniṣṭhuraḥ ||

tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan karuṇā¦
vyatiricyate || 69 ||
svakarmmapāśai sudṛḍhair vaddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagad duḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa | 70 ||
tathā dharmmātmanā cāpi doṣevya prahṛtaṃ tvayā ||
yathaiva cātmanaḥ sthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate || 71 ||

akṛtverṣyāṃ viśi
ṣṭeṣu hīnān apy avamanya ca ||
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ || 72 ||

paropakārajanmāno vidhinā vihi
tāśrayaḥ ||
jaladā sajalās tvaṃ hi saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ || 73 ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvarttate punaḥ || 74 ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ khagaḥ ||

svamāṃsāni ca da
ttani dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā || 75 ||
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ ||

sa punaḥ jīvan hi ślodyo yaḥ parā
rthe hi jīvati || 76 ||
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||
na hi svadehaśaityāya jāyate caṃdanadrumāḥ || 77 ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||
sapadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ || 78 ||

paropakāraikadhi
yaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ ||
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi || 79 ||

yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛ
ttāni pārthiva ||
eṣāt te sāsvatī kīrttir llokān anugamiṣyati || 80 ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā cirān mahīṃ |

sa
rvvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 81 ||

|| evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatuḥs tridaśā
layaṃ ||
rājā tu kratum iṣṭvā ca mumude devavac ciraṃ || 82 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śivesvaritam uttamaṃ ||

sa vihāyeha pā
pāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ || 83 ||
viciṃtya rājā svaśarīradhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvvajanasya durllabhaṃ ||

śarīradānā
t parijīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || 84 ||
